title: No UPnP gateway detected on a UPnP enabled device

labels.name: bug
labels.description: A problem with current functionality, as opposed to missing functionality (enhancement)

labels.name: frozen-due-to-age
labels.description: Issues closed and untouched for a long time, together with being locked for discussion

body:
Hello there.
I have 2 machines geographically separated, each behind a NAT, both connected thru a similar device, Technicolor TG784n.

I can only get them to connect when I input the external address of one of them in the configs. Unfortunatelly I was unable to get them to communicate thru UPnP.

Both **v0.9.0-beta1** and **v0.8.19** display a similar output on startup (_I was unable to compile the latest dev version myself tho_), indicating no UPnP gateway being detected:

**Syncthing statup**

```
[ZWZI7] 04:12:33 INFO: syncthing v0.9.0-beta1 (devel +6bdbf9086c00 Thu Jul 17 17:02:46 2014 +1000 linux-amd64 default) jb@jborg-mbp 2014-07-20 19:39:52 UTC
[ZWZI7] 04:12:33 INFO: My ID: XXXXX-XXXXX
[ZWZI7] 04:12:33 INFO: Starting web GUI on http://127.0.0.1:8080/
[ZWZI7] 04:12:33 INFO: Performing initial repository scan
[ZWZI7] 04:12:33 INFO: No UPnP gateway detected
[ZWZI7] 04:12:33 INFO: Sending local discovery announcements
[ZWZI7] 04:12:33 INFO: Sending global discovery announcements
[ZWZI7] 04:12:33 OK: Ready to synchronize default (read-write)
```

I've been digging around the device's configs and it seems all UPnP related options are enabled:

```
---------------- device: IGD/upnp/IGD.xml ------------
Advertised on: LocalNetwork (192.168.1.254)
-------------- devices/services ------------
++ Root Device: urn:schemas-upnp-org:device:InternetGatewayDevice:1
-- Service 1: urn:upnp-org:serviceId:L3Forwarding1
-- Service 2: urn:upnp-org:serviceId:LANHostCfg1
-- Service 3: urn:upnp-org:serviceId:WANCommonIFC1
-- Service 4: urn:upnp-org:serviceId:WANDSLLinkC1
-- Service 5: urn:upnp-org:serviceId:WANPPPConn1
---------------------- end -----------------
```

**$ upnpc -l** while Syncthing is running:

```
List of UPNP devices found on the network :
 desc: http://192.168.1.254:8000/hou74cq4tw9/IGD/upnp/IGD.xml
 st: urn:schemas-upnp-org:device:InternetGatewayDevice:1

Found valid IGD : http://192.168.1.254:8000/hou74cq4tw9/IGD/upnp/control/igd/wanpppc_1_1_1
Local LAN ip address : 192.168.1.75
Connection Type : IP_Routed
Status : Connected, uptime=159299s, LastConnectionError : ERROR_IP_CONFIGURATION
  Time started : Sun Jul 20 07:47:32 2014
MaxBitRateDown : 21176000 bps (21.1 Mbps)   MaxBitRateUp 1265000 bps (1.2 Mbps)
ExternalIPAddress = xx.xx.xx.xx
 i protocol exPort->inAddr:inPort description remoteHost leaseTime
 0 TCP 16092->192.168.1.75:16092 'BitTorrent Sync (TCP)' '' 0
 1 UDP 16092->192.168.1.75:16092 'BitTorrent Sync (UDP)' '' 0
GetGenericPortMappingEntry() returned 501 (Action Failed)
```

I also added a tcpdump log from a Syncthing restart : https://gist.github.com/GrimKriegor/fb180bec3f7c7282f3e6#file-syncthing_tcpdump

I'm unsure if I'm missing anything.
Thank you for your time!
